summary: Judicial pay, pension, and service conditions; SNJPC recommendations: pay matrix model with 2.81 multiplier; uniform designations; equivalence of district/higher judiciary; independence as basic structure; pension fixed at 50% of last pay; retirement age considerations; implementation from 01.01.2016; contempt petitions addressed compliance gaps.
legal_provisions_cited: All India Judges' Association (II) v. Union of India, (1993) 4 SCC 288
All India Judges' Association (III) v. Union of India, (2002) 4 SCC 247
All India Judges Association (3) v. Union of India (2010) 15 SCC 170
All India Judges Association v. Union of India (2019) 12 SCC 314
final_judgment: Court accepted/revised SNJPC recommendations on pay matrix, pension, designations, ACP benefits; directed implementation from 01.01.2016; contempt petitions addressed compliance deficiencies.
